replacements.>Un punto estimado no es una conclusión<: >A point estimate is not a conclusion
replacements.>Compara las versiones sobre los mismos: >Compare versions on the same cases, preserve the per-example difference, and report the effect together with its uncertainty. Then separate a detectable difference from one that is actually worthwhile in the product.
replacements.aria-label=\"Comparación pareada de dos: aria-label="Paired comparison of two versions on the same cases, followed by an estimate of the mean difference and its uncertainty"
replacements.>La unidad útil es la diferencia del mis: >The useful unit is the difference on the same example
replacements.>El intervalo se calcula sobre la estima: >Compute the interval for the estimator that matches your design. If A and B see the same cases, preserve that pairing when you compare them.
replacements.>El intervalo compatible con los datos t: >The interval compatible with the data still crosses 0.
replacements.>El intervalo queda a un lado de 0, pero: >The interval stays on one side of 0, but the effect remains inside the practical threshold defined for the product.
replacements.>El efecto y su intervalo superan el umb: >The effect and its interval exceed the improvement threshold that justifies additional cost, latency, or risk.
replacements.>¿Qué habría pasado con otra muestra del: >What would happen with another sample from the domain?
replacements.>El número de casos y la cobertura por s: >Case count and segment coverage determine how much you know about the target population.
replacements.>¿Qué cambia si repites el mismo caso?</: >What changes when you repeat the same case?
replacements.>Si la aleatoriedad forma parte del prod: >If randomness is part of the product, also measure run-to-run variability; do not confuse it with changing the sampled cases.
replacements.>mismos casos → comparación pareada; con: >same cases → paired comparison; preserve Δᵢ before aggregation
replacements.>efecto + intervalo + n + segmentos + va: >effect + interval + n + segments + run-to-run variability when applicable
replacements.>la evidencia estadística no sustituye e: >statistical evidence does not replace the product's practical-value threshold
